title: Hog Saga: The August Quest
tagline: Made for August AI by PostHog

music.mood: warm, hopeful, gentle adventure, calm optimism

text.win: The Guesswork Golem falls. Every answer measured, every new model tested, and users keep coming back.
text.lose: The guesswork won this round. Rest at the inn, drink some water, and try again.
text.credits: Made for the August AI team by PostHog

game.intro: Questions pour into August day and night. But which answers helped, and who never came back?

town.name: August HQ
town.inn_line: Rest up and hydrate. Your health companion insists.

regions.name: First Chat Meadow
regions.blurb: Where every user starts with one question.

regions.name: Lab Report Woods
regions.blurb: Dense with numbers. Somewhere a reply went wrong.

regions.name: Retention Dunes
regions.blurb: Dry and quiet. Where users stop coming back.

party.name: Dash
party.sprite_prompt: a data analyst with round glasses and a green sweater holding a tablet

party.name: Remy
party.sprite_prompt: a cheerful support lead with a headset and a light blue jacket

npcs.name: Night Owl
npcs.line: I asked August about my lab report at 2am and it helped! Does anyone at HQ know that?
npcs.sprite_prompt: a sleepy person in pajamas holding a glowing phone

npcs.name: Voice Noter
npcs.line: I send voice notes in Hindi. Does it work as well as English? Asking for my mum.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a smiling person holding a phone up to their mouth, wearing a yellow kurta

npcs.name: Model Tinkerer
npcs.line: We shipped a new model on Monday. Is it better? My gut says yes. My gut is not a dashboard.
npcs.sprite_prompt: an engineer with a messy bun and a green hoodie covered in sticky notes

enemies.name: Silent Churn
enemies.pain: They asked once, then never came back.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a tiny pale green ghost bug fading at the edges

enemies.name: Vibe Check
enemies.pain: New model shipped. Better? Nobody knows.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a quick little dark green beetle with a question mark on its back

enemies.name: Funnel Leak
enemies.pain: Signups that never ask a first question.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a big round bug shaped like a dripping funnel

enemies.name: Log Swamp
enemies.pain: No analytics set up, just raw logs.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a heavy grey slug covered in scrolling paper printouts

enemies.name: Babel Moth
enemies.pain: Voice notes in many languages, no view.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a large moth with wings patterned like speech bubbles

boss.name: Guesswork Golem
boss.taunt: You'll never know which answers helped!
boss.phase2: More features! Shipped on vibes alone!
boss.sprite_prompt: a giant stone golem with a blank face and a fog cloud around its head, green moss on its shoulders
